learn.explanation:
**used to + yalın fiil**, geçmişte **düzenli olarak yapılan** ya da **süren** ama **artık devam etmeyen** şeyleri anlatır.

| Tür | Örnek |
|---|---|
| Alışkanlık | I **used to play** football every day. (Artık oynamıyorum.) |
| Durum | I **used to have** long hair. (Artık uzun değil.) |
| Durum | We **used to live** in Amasya. |

**Yapı:** Tüm kişilerde aynı → I / you / he / she / we / they **used to** + fiil

**Dikkat:**

- used to'dan sonra **yalın fiil**: I used to **play** (~~played~~ / ~~playing~~)
- used to **sadece geçmiş** içindir. Şimdiki alışkanlık için present simple: I **usually** play tennis. (~~I use to play~~)
- Tek seferlik olaylar için kullanılmaz: ~~I used to go to Paris in 2015.~~ → I **went** to Paris in 2015.

**Telaffuz:** used to → /ˈjuːstə/ ("yustı")

There used to be a cinema on this street.

learn.explanation:
**Olumsuz ve soru** hallerinde **did** kullanılır ve **use to** (d olmadan) yazılır:

| | Yapı | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| Olumlu | used to + fiil | I **used to** play outside. |
| Olumsuz | **didn't use to** + fiil | We **didn't use to** have a TV. |
| Soru | **Did** + özne + **use to** + fiil? | **Did** you **use to** get pocket money? |
| Soru kelimeli | Wh- + did + özne + use to? | **What did** you **use to** do? |
| Kısa cevap | | Yes, I **did**. / No, I **didn't**. |

**Neden "use"?** Çünkü did varsa fiil yalın olur (did + go, did + use).

**Olumsuz için alternatif:** **never used to** → I **never used to** eat vegetables.

**Günlük konuşmada** "Did you use to...?" yerine çoğu zaman sadece past simple de kullanılır: **Did you have** a TV when you were a child?

lessons.title: Her yaz giderdik
lessons.goal: would ile geçmişte tekrarlanan eylemleri anlatabilir, would ile used to'nun farkını bilirim.

discover.title: Köydeki yazlar
discover.body:
When I was a child, I used to spend every summer at my grandparents' farm near Bolu.

Every morning, my grandfather would wake me up at six. We would walk to the field together, and he would tell me the names of all the plants and birds. My grandmother would make fresh bread, and the whole house would smell wonderful.

In the afternoons, my cousins and I would play hide and seek in the barn. We would come home covered in dust, and my grandmother would pretend to be angry.

I used to be a very shy child, but on the farm I was free and happy. The farm isn't there any more, but I still remember every corner of it.

questions.prompt: What time would the writer's grandfather wake them up?
questions.explanation: "my grandfather would wake me up at six"

questions.prompt: Is the farm still there?

learn.explanation:
**would + yalın fiil** de geçmişte **tekrarlanan eylemleri** anlatır. Özellikle anı ve hikâyelerde çok kullanılır.

- Every morning, my grandfather **would wake** me up at six.
- We **would play** hide and seek for hours.

**used to mu would mu?**

| | used to | would |
|---|---|---|
| Tekrarlanan **eylem** | ✓ We used to play outside. | ✓ We would play outside. |
| **Durum** (be, have, live, like, know) | ✓ I used to be shy. | ✗ ~~I would be shy.~~ |
| | ✓ We used to live in Bolu. | ✗ ~~We would live in Bolu.~~ |

**Anlatımda:** Hikâyeye genellikle **used to** ile başlanır, sonra **would** ile devam edilir (tekrar etmemek için):

- I **used to** spend summers at the farm. Every morning, my grandfather **would** wake me up...

**Dikkat:** Bu "would" conditional değildir; anlamı "-ardı / -erdi"dir.

examples.en: On Sundays, my father would cook breakfast for everyone.

learn.turkishNote: Türkçedeki "-ardı / -erdi" eki hem eylemler hem durumlar için kullanılır ("giderdik", "utangaçtım"). İngilizcede ise would sadece eylemler için kullanılabilir. Durum fiilleri için (be, have, live, love, know) mutlaka used to kullanın.

lessons.title: Artık değil
lessons.goal: Geçmiş ile bugünü any more, no longer ve still ile karşılaştırabilirim.

discover.title: O zaman ve şimdi: Çocuk olmak
discover.body:
In those days, children used to play outside until it got dark. Today, many children no longer play in the street. They spend more time at home, on tablets and phones.

Children used to make their own toys. Now most toys come from shops, and many of them need batteries.

In the past, families used to eat dinner together every evening. In many homes, this doesn't happen any more, because parents work late.

But some things haven't changed. Children still love stories, they still laugh at silly jokes, and they still want their parents' attention.

learn.explanation:
**Değişimi anlatmak:**

| İfade | Yeri | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **not ... any more** | cümle sonu | I **don't** play football **any more**. |
| **no longer** | fiilden önce (be'den sonra) | I **no longer** play football. / The shop **is no longer** open. |
| **still** | fiilden önce (be'den sonra) | I **still** play football. / She **is still** my best friend. |

**no longer** daha resmîdir ve fiil **olumlu** kalır:

- I **no longer live** there. (~~I don't no longer live~~)

**any more** ile fiil **olumsuz** olur:

- I **don't live** there **any more**.

**Karşılaştırma kalıbı:**

- I **used to** ..., but **now** I ...
- I **used to** ..., but I **don't** ... **any more**.
- I **didn't use to** ..., but **now** I ...
- I **still** ...

examples.tr: Eskiden et yerdim ama artık yemiyorum.

learn.explanation:
**Bir anıyı anlatırken zamanları birleştirin:**

| Zaman | Görevi | Örnek |
|---|---|---|
| **used to** | genel arka plan, durumlar | He **used to be** quite strict. |
| **would** | tekrarlanan sahneler | Every Friday, he **would read** to us. |
| **past simple** | tek bir olay | One day, he **brought** a puppy to class! |
| **past continuous** | o anda süren | We **were sitting** on the floor when ... |
| **still / no longer** | bugüne bağlantı | He **no longer** teaches, but he **still** reads. |

**Anı anlatmak için kalıplar:**

- **One of my earliest memories is** ...
- **I'll never forget** the day when ...
- **I remember** + -ing: I remember **sitting** on the floor.
- **Looking back**, ... (Geriye dönüp bakınca)
- **It makes me smile when I think about** it.

examples.en: One of my earliest memories is my third birthday.
examples.tr: En eski anılarımdan biri üçüncü doğum günüm.

Looking back, I had a very happy childhood.

task.prompt: "Unutamadığım bir çocukluk anısı" başlıklı bir yazı yazın (130–160 kelime). used to ile arka planı kurun, would ile tekrarlanan sahneleri anlatın, past simple / past continuous ile özel bir olayı aktarın ve still / no longer ile bugüne bağlayın.
task.modelAnswer:
One of my earliest memories is of my grandfather's small shop in Tokat. He used to sell newspapers, sweets and toys, and I used to think it was the most exciting place in the world.

Every day after school, I would run to the shop. My grandfather would give me a piece of lokum, and I would sit behind the counter and watch the customers.

I'll never forget one winter afternoon. It was snowing heavily and the shop was empty. My grandfather was reading his newspaper when he suddenly looked up and said, "Let's build the biggest snowman in Tokat!" We closed the shop and played in the snow for two hours.

The shop no longer exists, and my grandfather died ten years ago. But I still remember the smell of the newspapers, and it still makes me smile when I think about that day.
rubric: Past simple / continuous ile özel olay

questions.modelAnswer: When I was a child, I used to live in a small town near Samsun. I didn't use to have many toys, but I had lots of friends. Every afternoon, we would play football in the street until our mothers called us for dinner. At weekends, my father would take us fishing. I used to be very naughty, and my teachers used to complain about me! Today, my life is very different. I no longer live in a small town; I live in a big city, and I don't play football in the street any more. I didn't use to like reading, but now I read every evening. Some things haven't changed, though. I still love fishing, and I still talk to my childhood friends every week.
rubric: used to / didn't use to / would
